user.title: RealTimeTrains
user.description: Get a long-lived token from https://api-portal.rtt.io. The home station is the station whose departures you want to see.

data_description.token: The long-lived (refresh) token from the RTT API portal.
data_description.station: Station code, e.g. CLJ for Clapham Junction (a short or long code).
data_description.max_departures: How many departure sensors to create (1-20).

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate RealTimeTrains
reauth_confirm.description: RTT rejected the stored token. Enter a new long-lived token.

data_description.token: Leave blank to keep the current token.

error.invalid_station: RTT does not recognise that station code.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the RTT API.
error.rate_limited: The RTT rate limit was hit. Try again shortly.
error.window_order: The second time window must be longer than the first.

init.title: Polling schedule
init.description: How often to poll depends on how soon the next train leaves. Each poll uses one API call (plus one for any new or re-timed train).

data.slow_interval: Slow poll interval (nothing due within the medium window)

error.window_order: The medium window must be longer than the fast window.
